visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal slider of linked image tiles (price ranges, new arrivals, styles)
visualCharacteristics.summary: Multi-item slider showing several rectangular/portrait linked image tiles per view, side arrows
visualCharacteristics.layout: Several tiles per view (about 2 on mobile, 3 on tablet, 4-5 on desktop), side arrows, swipe/scroll; images keep their natural aspect ratio; few tiles are centered without arrows

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tile image; cell 2 (optional): label and/or link. One link makes the whole tile clickable
contentPattern.source: 6 linked price-range image tiles (Under 2K ... 25K+) in a scrolling slider | ~10 linked portrait campaign images (Raga Paris, Roamer, Edge Fumage, Zero Hour Divers, ...) | 5 linked style images (Minimal & Chic, Bold & Edgy, Luxe & Classy, Together/Bandhan, Casual & Sporty)

usage: Product/collection entry points that need more items than fit in one row.
reuseGuidance: Use when tiles should scroll. If all tiles should be visible in a grid use cards-image-tiles.
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
